name: Lanseria International Airport

runway.v: Runway 07/25, 2996 m x 45 m, asphalt. (SACAA chart effective 20 Jun 2019; check against the current AIP).

fuel.v: Jet A1 by hydrant on the main apron and by bowser. Between 19:00 and 05:00 refuelling is on the main apron only.
fuel.quote: Jet A1 refuelling by means of Hydrant on main apron and bowsers. Please note between 19:00 and 05:00 refuelling will only be done on the main apron.

hours.v: Tower and approach control 24 hours. Ground movement control 05:45 to 19:00 daily.
hours.quote: Tower and Approach control service: 24 hours; Ground movement control service: [05h45 – 19h00] daily

permits.v: Foreign (non-South African) carriers need a Foreign Operator Permit for scheduled or non-scheduled commercial international services. Class IV services with up to 8 passengers or 1,000 kg, and no carriage within South Africa, are exempt from the permit but need special permission from the National Department of Transport before filing a flight plan. National rule; no notice period on the page
permits.quote: All non- South African air carriers that wish to undertake scheduled or non scheduled commercial international air services

handling.v: the operator's Airport Services page lists NAC and ExecuJet as fixed base operators (FBOs) at Lanseria; it does not say handling is mandatory
handling.quote: NAC’s Fixed Base Operation (FBO) at Lanseria International Airport (ICAO: FALA) offers clients a comprehensive suite
